Claim Disqualification - Section 16(1)(d.notes_template:
QUERY: Claim rejected / disqualified under Section 16(1)(d) of the UI Act.
CAUSE: Applicant answered 'No' to 'Are you a work seeker?' and/or 'Are you capable and available for work?' during the online application process.
STATUS: Claim inspected on dashboard. Disqualification under Section 16(1)(d) confirmed. Explained that statutory requirement applies to all applicants, including retired contributors.
ADVICE: Advised client they must re-apply at their nearest Labour Centre and ensure they answer 'Yes' to both questions during the application process.
ACTION: Concluded call as First Call Resolution (FCR). Case status updated to Resolved.
probingQuestions: Did you select 'No' to 'Are you a work seeker?' or 'Are you capable and available for work?' during your application?
